args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). This PR upgrades fastjson to 2.9.4, the first patched release in the 2.x line.

- Updated `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`
- CI: passed
